record.nameMeaning: "Sinew lizard", for its tendon-stiffened back and tail
record.oneLiner: A medium-sized ornithopod with an unusually long, stiffened tail.
record.description: Tenontosaurus was a medium-sized iguanodontian ornithopod with an unusually long, broad tail stiffened by a network of bony tendons. It lived in Early Cretaceous western North America and is often found associated with the predator Deinonychus.

notableFacts.text: Its long tail and back were stiffened by a network of bony tendons.
Frequently found alongside the predator Deinonychus.
